module_summary: Pattern-triggered timer: FSM detects 1101, shifts 4 delay bits into a down counter, counts (delay+1)*1000 cycles with a 1000-cycle prescaler, then waits for ack.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Search/shift/count/wait controller; decodes shift_ena, counting and done.

anchors.name: scount
anchors.why: Delay register loaded by shifting data, then decremented every 1000 cycles.

anchors.name: fcount
anchors.why: 0-999 prescaler running while counting; wrap decrements scount.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Timeout notification held in Wait state until ack.

anchors.name: ack
anchors.why: User acknowledge returning FSM from Wait to pattern search.

anchors.name: counting
anchors.why: Count-state indication; also enables fcount and scount decrement.

anchors.name: shift_ena
anchors.why: Enables shifting four delay bits into scount during B0-B3.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: Serial input carrying start pattern and delay bits.

anchors.name: done_counting
anchors.why: Terminal-count flag moving FSM from Count to Wait.

groups.name: Timer controller
groups.description: FSM searching 1101, sequencing shift, count and wait phases.

groups.name: Delay counters
groups.description: Shift-loaded delay down counter with 1000-cycle prescaler.

groups.name: Done/ack handshake
groups.description: Done held until user ack restarts search.
